meta.description: Structured learning paths for ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi Pico and more. Projects, simulator, AI mentor.

home.heroTitle: From your first LED blink to your own IoT project.
home.heroSubtitle: 4 paths · 24 lessons · an AI mentor that knows your code at every step. In English and German.
